summary: {director} brings the replacement order for a damaged traffic signal pole and tells the council an insurance payment has arrived.
realLife: Dickson’s public works director described the damaged pole and reported receipt of insurance money before council approved the replacement order.
gates: Damaged signal, purchase order and confirmed insurance payment.
inGame: needs: damaged signal, purchase order and confirmed insurance payment.

turns.pulledBy: The insurance payment covers the approved cost.
turns.what: Apply it to the replacement expense.
turns.writesBack: Record the reimbursement and purchase separately..

turns.pulledBy: The replacement costs more than the payment.
turns.writesBack: Return the gap to the responsible budget..
